title: Finite generation for the `K(n)` -local sphere

result.label: Finite generation for the `K(n)` -local sphere
result.statement: Answers the degreewise finiteness question of Hovey and Hovey–Strickland: every homotopy group of the K(n)-local sphere is a finitely generated ℤ p -module, for every prime, positive height and integer degree. The same conclusion holds after K(n)-localizing any finite p -local spectrum.
